description: Gold-standard query pack for the GSF IR Support Library — a non-legal US Bank internal troubleshooting guide. Tests cover import issues, VDI/Citrix, package-PDF workflow, Excel/macro errors, workflow problems, and terminology. This is the canonical non-legal-doc RAG benchmark; target avg score >= 4.5 / 5.0 using all RAG features (HyDE, CRAG, critique-loop, dual-vector, graph, BM25 fusion).

document.notes: 12 144-line Markdown file. No predefined sections — structured as a flat FAQ list of Category / Description / Possible Cause-Solution triples.

test_groups.description: Queries about import errors, cutoff data, SSIS failures, and map problems

queries.query: How do I fix a duplicate key error during import even though the data is not found in tblServ?
queries.rationale: Exact FAQ: 'Duplicate key error even if data not found in tblServ'. Terms co-occur in the solution row.

queries.query: What should I do if tblLoanCutoffOrig is wiped out after the first payment has been made?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'If tblLoanCutoffOrig is wiped out / IMPORT PREFUNDING CUTOFF'. Both terms appear in same paragraph.

queries.query: How can I find the details of why an SSIS import failed now that email notifications are blocked?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Import Fails / querying ProcessingStatus from tblImportLog'. Unique pair.

queries.query: What does SSIS Error Code DTS_E_OLEDBERROR mean and what causes it during import?
queries.rationale: The error string DTS_E_OLEDBERROR appears verbatim in the import fails section alongside OLE DB.

queries.query: How do I fix the error 'The package format was migrated from version 6 to version 8' when importing from iManage?
queries.rationale: Exact error message appears in 'Trouble with Import' section, solution is iApplication_Cleaner.

test_groups.description: Queries about Citrix Receiver resets, VDI printer problems, iManage launch failures

queries.query: What should I do when iManage fails to open or process files and throws an Excel Interop error?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'iManage fails..Excel.Interop error'. Solution mentions Quick Repair and uninstalling Teams.

queries.query: What script should I run when the VDI won't open and I have to end all related processes in Task Manager?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'VDI won't open / Run K:\...\Citrix_Receiver_Reset.CMD'. Terms co-occur directly.

queries.query: Why does the default printer on VDI keep reverting to Citrix Universal Printer and cause iManage reports to generate incorrectly?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Default Printer in VDI / Bank policy forces default printer to Citrix UNIVERSAL Printer'. XPS is the fix.

queries.query: How do I fix the Citrix error 'cannot create a secure connection in this browser' after logging in?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Logging into Citrix via browser... Citrix Workspace app cannot create a secure connection'. Unique article ID CTX134123.

test_groups.description: Queries about package-PDF failures, signoff errors, and file lock problems

queries.query: How do I fix the archive report error 'Final package changed since signoff'?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Archive report error Final package changed since signoff'. Solution is revert to Processor Signoff.

queries.query: How do I resolve 'System detected a revision for this deal, confirm if revision stamp is needed' in ExportPackagePDF?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Error in ExportPackagePDF: System detected a revision'. Exact fix: enable Revise Stamp, revert to Generate Auto Reports.

queries.query: What causes the ExportPackagePDF error about Delinquency Summary Report not being generated for a support package?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'ExportPackagePDF...Delinquency Summary Report could not be generated'. Solution: add underlying pages to support package.

queries.query: Who should I contact when things are not working as expected in Pivot and reports are not posting?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Pivot / Things aren't working as expected / send email to Pivot.Support@usbank.com / submit via Pivot Support Submission Form'. Both unique strings co-occur in the same section.

queries.query: How do I fix the 'Signoff Processor Error: Subquery returned more than 1 value'?
queries.rationale: Exact error message: 'Error in ProcessorSignoff: Subquery returned more than 1 value'. Solution: check for more than one Account Administrator.

test_groups.description: Queries about iRibbon macros, Excel security settings, #NAME errors, and VBA trust

queries.query: What does the FormulaFix_IR macro do and when should it be used?
queries.rationale: FormulaFix_IR is defined explicitly in the iRibbonMacroList section with reference to GlobalMacro.xlam.

queries.query: How do I fix 'Microsoft has blocked macros from running because the source of this file is untrusted'?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Microsoft has blocked macros from running because the source of this file is untrusted'. Fix references Trust Center settings.
queries.section_hint: Macro Microsoft has blocked macros section

queries.query: How do I enable automatic update of links in Excel to fix the potential security concern popup?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Get this pop-up every time Excel opens: Automatic update of links has been disabled'. Fix: Trust Center > External Content > Workbook Links.

queries.query: How do I request or remove entitlement access for an application using the new Access Management system?
queries.rationale: FAQ: 'Request Entitlement / in new Access Management, select Manage User Access'. Unique action phrase co-occurring in one section.

test_groups.description: Queries about GSF IR acronyms, support channels, and processing concepts

queries.query: What does BAU mean in GSF IR and what is an example of a BAU issue?
queries.rationale: Acronyms section explicitly defines BAU as 'Business As Usual' with an iManage example.

queries.query: What is the recommended support flow to follow when you encounter a system issue in GSF IR?
queries.rationale: FAQ 'Available Troubleshooting Resources': flow is Peers > Resources > Manager > iTracker Ticket. Teams channel is 'GSF IR System Issues'.

scoring.notes: Design objective: avg >= 4.5 (nearly all queries at score 4-5). Terms chosen as verbatim co-occurring strings from the support library ensuring retrieval confidence.
